energyEfficiencyClasses.description: Optional energy certificate classes (A+ is the best). Not available for plots, garages and assisted living.
energyEfficiencyClasses.title: Energy efficiency classes

equipment.description: Optional amenity filters. The source applies them to apartments, houses, flat-share rooms, temporary living and assisted living.
equipment.title: Equipment

includeDetails.description: Fetch the full expose for every result. This fills the price breakdown, energy certificate, amenities, full address, description and agent phone. Turn off for a cheaper card-only run.
includeDetails.title: Fetch full listing details

keyword.description: Optional free-text keyword matched in the listing (for example Altbau, Garten or möbliert).
keyword.title: Keyword

livingSpaceMax.description: Maximum living area in square metres.
livingSpaceMax.title: Maximum living space (m²)

livingSpaceMin.description: Minimum living area in square metres.
livingSpaceMin.title: Minimum living space (m²)

location.description: Used when no URL is supplied. A city name (Berlin, München, Köln), a state/city path (bayern/muenchen) or a geocode path (/de/berlin/berlin, /at/wien/wien). Leave empty to use only the URLs above.
location.title: Location

maxItems.description: Maximum number of listing records to save.
maxItems.title: Max listings

maxPages.description: Maximum search-result pages to read per search URL or location. Each page holds up to 100 listings; the source paginates deeply, so raise this for large exports.
maxPages.title: Max result pages per search

mode.description: How to search. Auto uses the URLs you paste and also runs the location builder when a location is set. Choose URLs to ignore the builder fields, or Location to ignore pasted URLs.
mode.title: Mode

newBuildingOnly.description: Return only listings marked as new builds.
newBuildingOnly.title: New buildings only

priceMax.description: Maximum asking price. For rentals this is the monthly rent according to the price basis below.
priceMax.title: Maximum price (EUR)

priceMin.description: Minimum asking price. For rentals this is the monthly rent according to the price basis below.
priceMin.title: Minimum price (EUR)

priceType.description: Which rent figure the price range and result ordering refer to. Ignored for sale searches.
priceType.title: Rent price basis

publishedAfter.description: Optional ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Only listings published on or after this date are returned.
publishedAfter.title: Published after

realEstateType.description: The kind of property to search for when building a search from a location. Includes residential, commercial, plot, garage and auction types. URL searches use the type in the URL instead.
realEstateType.title: Property type (location mode)

roomsMax.description: Maximum number of rooms. Half rooms are allowed (for example 4.5).
roomsMax.title: Maximum rooms

roomsMin.description: Minimum number of rooms. Half rooms are allowed (for example 2.5).
roomsMin.title: Minimum rooms

sorting.description: Result ordering. Newest first is the source default.
sorting.title: Sort order

startUrls.description: ImmoScout24 search URLs (for example https://www.immobilienscout24.de/Suche/de/berlin/berlin/wohnung-kaufen), radius/shape searches, or direct expose URLs (https://www.immobilienscout24.de/expose/123456789). All filters in the URL are carried over. The legacy searchUrls key is still accepted.
startUrls.title: ImmoScout24 search or listing URLs

title: ImmoScout24 Property Listings & Price Breakdown Input
